About

A dedicated partner for the aircraft owner.

Vapor Trails Aviation LLC is a corporate aviation management company based in the Lake Worth and Palm Beach area. We manage a variety of corporate jets for owners who expect their aircraft to be ready, compliant, and cared for at all times.

We handle the details of ownership, from day-to-day operations and maintenance planning to buying or selling an aircraft. Each client gets one point of contact who answers for the whole operation.

Services

Complete stewardship of your aircraft.

01

Aircraft Management

Full oversight of your aircraft's operation, so ownership stays effortless.

  • Operational planning & scheduling
  • Budgeting & transparent reporting
  • Hangar, insurance & vendor coordination
  • Records & regulatory compliance
02

Maintenance Oversight

Owner-side supervision of inspections, repairs, and upgrades, so the work is done right and on time.

  • Inspection & maintenance planning
  • MRO selection & on-site oversight

  • Avionics & interior projects
03

Acquisitions & Sales

Guidance through every step of buying or selling a corporate jet.

  • Records & history review
  • Closing & delivery coordination
04

Crew & Charter Coordination

Support for staffing your flight department and coordinating charter when it fits your goals.

  • Crew sourcing & scheduling
  • Training coordination
  • Charter coordination
  • Trip support
